_about: The only model files Koe will load: official, openly licensed models from their makers (`maker`, `license`, `card` = the maker's model page; `published_by` = who published this exact converted file). Each is pinned to an exact Hugging Face commit and SHA-256 (the Git LFS id Hugging Face publishes); the app refuses any file whose hash does not match, and scripts/get-models.sh downloads from these URLs and checks the same hashes. Within a kind, entries are in quality order: with no model chosen in the app, the first installed one that verifies is used. `tiers` says which `get-models.sh --tier` installs each file; `hybrid` marks Qwen3 models that think before answering unless told not to.

tiers.compact: Speech only (0.5 GB): pastes what you said, with punctuation. No cleanup model.
tiers.balanced: Best accuracy for the size. The default.
tiers.max: Strongest cleanup, but keeps ~20 GB of memory in use while Koe runs. Best on Macs with 48 GB or more; needs at least 32 GB.

models.label: Whisper large-v3 turbo
models.note: Most accurate, especially on names and jargon.

models.label: Whisper small (English)
models.note: A third of the size; a little less accurate.

models.label: Whisper base (English)
models.note: Smallest and fastest to load; noticeably less accurate.

models.label: Qwen3 30B-A3B
models.note: Mixture-of-experts: 30B parameters, about 3B active per word, so it stays quick.

models.label: Qwen3 4B Instruct
models.note: Handles self-corrections, lists, and tone well.
